# Vendored OpenSceneGraph packages

These are unmodified Ubuntu binary packages used by
`tools/setup_local_osg.py` for a no-sudo installation.

- `ubuntu20.04-amd64`: OpenSceneGraph 3.6.4 and GL development packages from
  Ubuntu 20.04.
- `ubuntu22.04-arm64`: OpenSceneGraph 3.6.5 and GL development/runtime packages
  from Ubuntu 22.04 ports.

Package metadata, copyright files, and licenses are contained in each `.deb`.
The original packages and source links are available from
<https://packages.ubuntu.com/>.
